module.name: AWS EKS Cluster
module.description: Creates AWS EKS cluster with managed node groups, OIDC provider, and cluster add-ons (VPC CNI, CoreDNS, kube-proxy, EBS CSI driver).

required.reason: Requires VPC and subnets for cluster and node placement
Requires IAM roles and security groups for cluster and nodes

required.name: vpc_id
required.description: ID of the VPC for EKS cluster

required.name: private_external_subnet_ids
required.description: Private external subnet IDs for EKS cluster endpoint

required.name: private_internal_subnet_ids
required.description: Private internal subnet IDs for EKS node groups

required.name: eks_cluster_role_arn
required.description: ARN of the IAM role for EKS cluster

required.name: nodegroup_role_arn
required.description: ARN of the IAM role for EKS node groups

required.name: vpc_security_group_id
required.description: ID of the security group for cluster communication

required.name: infrastructure_key_name
required.description: Name of the SSH key pair for node access

optional.name: node_instance_types
optional.description: EC2 instance types for node groups

optional.name: cluster_endpoint_public_access
optional.description: Enable public access to cluster endpoint

optional.name: cluster_endpoint_private_access
optional.description: Enable private access to cluster endpoint

optional.name: enable_cluster_addons
optional.description: Enable EKS cluster add-ons (VPC CNI, CoreDNS, kube-proxy, EBS CSI)

optional.name: ebs_csi_addon_version
optional.description: Version of the EBS CSI driver addon

optional.name: efs_csi_addon_version
optional.description: Version of the EFS CSI driver addon

optional.name: instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for worker nodes

optional.name: kubernetes_version
optional.description: Kubernetes version for the EKS cluster

optional.name: node_count
optional.description: Number of worker nodes in the EKS node group

optional.name: snapshot_controller_addon_version
optional.description: Version of the snapshot controller addon

optional.name: user_ip
optional.description: Your public IP address in CIDR format (e.g., 203.123.45.67/32) for EKS API endpoint access

key_outputs.name: cluster_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Endpoint URL for EKS cluster API server

key_outputs.name: cluster_certificate_authority_data
key_outputs.description: Base64 encoded certificate data for cluster CA

key_outputs.name: oidc_provider_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the IAM OIDC provider for service accounts

key_outputs.name: kubectl_config_command
key_outputs.description: AWS CLI command to configure kubectl

key_outputs.name: cluster_security_group_id
key_outputs.description: Security group ID attached to the EKS cluster
